summary: A fresh macOS debug launch reproduced the indefinite startup screen. A process sample located the wait in flutter_secure_storage's legacy Keychain lookup; moving the session cookie to a versioned service allowed startup to reach login without deleting old Keychain items.

checks.name: Startup stall reproduced
checks.observation: The debug app remained on ‘Подключаемся к гильдии…’ for more than three minutes. A read-only process sample showed the flutter_secure_storage_service queue blocked in SecItemCopyMatching → ItemImpl::getContent → CSSM_DecryptDataFinal.

checks.name: Versioned macOS Keychain configuration
checks.observation: The session cookie now uses the isolated legacy service ru.boohtacord.boohtacordDesktop.session.v2, avoiding the previously used service. Existing Keychain entries were not read or deleted. The targeted configuration regression test passes.

checks.name: Full Flutter tests and analysis
checks.observation: All 236 Flutter tests passed and flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-pub reported no issues.

checks.name: Fresh macOS debug startup
checks.observation: flutter build macos --debug --no-pub succeeded. A fresh flutter run reached the signed-out login/register screen and showed the configured API endpoint; no account login or mutating API action was performed.

checks.name: Existing session restored by a fresh debug process
checks.command: flutter run -d macos; inspect the newly launched app window
checks.observation: The Debug app was not running before this launch. After startup it loaded the authenticated workspace without re-entering credentials. Flutter reported 'Failed to foreground app; open returned 1', but the app window was available for accessibility inspection. No credentials, cookies, or message bodies were inspected. This verifies session-cookie read/restore through the versioned Keychain service, but not a new login write cycle.

checks.name: Windows cross-platform tests, analysis and Release build
checks.observation: GitVerse run 1678534 on the same source revision passed all 236 Flutter tests, analysis and flutter build windows --release.

checks.name: Cookie persistence across successful login and relaunch
checks.observation: The focused storage-options test passed, and a fresh debug process restored an existing signed-in session. A new successful login/write cycle and one-time re-login for cookies held under the previous Keychain service were not exercised.

remaining: Verify a new successful macOS login/write cycle and the one-time re-login behavior for cookies stored under previous Keychain service names; separately validate a Developer ID-signed release.
